g.text: Notification System: One Event, Fanned Out Through Preferences
A single triggering event, checked once, sent through only the channels the user actually wants
Enabled once, at ingestion: preference + dedup + rate-limit checks happen ONE time,
in the Notification Service -- not re-implemented separately inside each channel worker.
A channel that's down (e.g. email provider outage) retries independently and never blocks the others.
